meta.name: pet-commerce-creator
meta.description: 萌宠带货短视频全流程创作技能，基于COZE视频大模型API，支持萌宠剧情/好物测评/品种科普/宠品带货等全类型创作，覆盖爆款解析反推、知识库联动、互动优化、素材批量下载、全素材整合，实现从创意到带货引流型成品视频的自动化生成，适配15-30秒竖屏9:16主流平台规格。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成萌宠带货短视频，适配竖屏规格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要做萌宠类带货短视频，从创意到成品一键生成
copy.tagline_en: Auto-generate pet e-commerce short videos in vertical format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create pet e-commerce short videos from idea to final product

howto.what: 装了这个技能后,Claude 能帮你制作 15~30 秒竖屏萌宠带货短视频:解析爆款链接、写带货脚本、设计分镜、生成字幕音效素材,并调用 COZE API 合成成品视频,还支持全流程质检和二次创作。
howto.when: 当你提出萌宠故事、测评等带货短视频创作需求,或给出抖音/B站等视频链接要求解析反推时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个 15 秒的猫粮测评带货视频
say.note: 会启动创作流程,产出脚本、分镜和成品视频。
会下载视频并生成爆款解析报告。

say.text: 按上次的互动数据优化卖点,重新合成一版
say.note: 会回溯修改并产出优化后的视频。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude create 15-30s vertical pet-promo videos: parse viral links, write scripts, storyboard, generate assets, and assemble final video via COZE API, including QC and re-creation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for pet short-video creation (stories, reviews, etc.) or provide a video link (Douyin/Bilibili, etc.) for analysis and reverse-engineering.

say_en.text: Make a 15-second cat food review promo video.
say_en.note: Starts the creation flow and outputs script, storyboard, final video.
Downloads video and generates a viral-analysis report.

say_en.text: Optimize selling points based on the last engagement data and re-render.
say_en.note: Goes back, modifies, and produces an improved video.
